selected_evidence.requirement: Create appworker and configure persistent resource limits
selected_evidence.summary: Shows the account, limits-file contents and permissions, home ownership, and a login session reporting soft/hard nofile=8192 and nproc=256.
Captures the original boot ID with healthy SSH/account/session limits, followed by safe reboot scheduling acknowledgement.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 changed boot identity and recovered state
selected_evidence.summary: Proves a new boot ID, then confirms SSH is active, appworker and its home persist, and a fresh login session still receives both requested limits.

commands.command:
set -eu
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'identity='; id
if getent passwd appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then getent passwd appworker; else printf 'appworker=absent\n'; fi
printf 'pam_limits_common_session='; grep -Ec '^[[:space:]]*session[[:space:]]+required[[:space:]]+pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d/common-session || true
printf 'pam_limits_common_session_noninteractive='; grep -Ec '^[[:space:]]*session[[:space:]]+required[[:space:]]+pam_limits\.so' /etc/pam.d/common-session-noninteractive || true
printf 'ssh_active='; systemctl is-active ssh || true
printf 'ssh_enabled='; systemctl is-enabled ssh || true
printf 'existing_appworker_limits='; grep -R '^[[:space:]]*appworker[[:space:]]' /etc/security/limits.conf /etc/security/limits.d 2>/dev/null || true
commands.stdout:
boot_id=0256e3f5-9f2d-48f3-b55b-12f9f4d599ab
identity=uid=1000(antrieb) gid=1000(antrieb) groups=1000(antrieb)
appworker=absent
pam_limits_common_session=0
pam_limits_common_session_noninteractive=0
ssh_active=active
ssh_enabled=enabled
existing_appworker_limits=

sshd -T 2>/dev/null | grep '^usepam ' || true

commands.command:
set -eu
if ! getent passwd appworker >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash appworker; fi
printf '%s\n' 'appworker - nofile 8192' 'appworker - nproc 256' | sudo -n tee /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf >/dev/null
sudo -n chown root:root /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf
sudo -n chmod 0644 /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf
getent passwd appworker
sudo -n stat -c 'limits_file=%n owner=%U:%G mode=%a' /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf
sudo -n sed -n '1,20p' /etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf
commands.stdout:
appworker:x:1001:1001::/home/appworker:/bin/bash
limits_file=/etc/security/limits.d/99-appworker.conf owner=root:root mode=644
appworker - nofile 8192
appworker - nproc 256

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo -n su - appworker -c 'printf "session_user="; id -un; printf "session_home="; pwd; printf "nofile_soft="; ulimit -Sn; printf "nofile_hard="; ulimit -Hn; printf "nproc_soft="; ulimit -Su; printf "nproc_hard="; ulimit -Hu'
printf 'home_owner='; stat -c '%U:%G' /home/appworker
commands.stdout:
session_user=appworker
session_home=/home/appworker
nofile_soft=8192
nofile_hard=8192
nproc_soft=256
nproc_hard=256
home_owner=appworker:appworker
